info.name: RAINBOHz rendering-engine server API
info.description:
Tests of the rendering engine's REST API (rendering-engine/docs/server.md, rendering-engine/api/openapi.yaml), run in order against a server started with `make run-rendering-engine-server`.

Set `repoRoot` to the repository's absolute path (`pwd -P` at its top) and, if the server is not on 127.0.0.1:8080, `baseUrl`. Then run the whole collection in the Collection Runner, or:

```
newman run rendering-engine/test/postman/rendering-engine.postman_collection.json \
    --env-var repoRoot="$(pwd -P)"
```

Folders depend on those before them. Generated by make_postman_collection.py from the OpenAPI document; edit that script, not this file.

item.name: 1 No score
item.description: A load that fails discards the score held before it, so after it every call that needs a score answers 409 (server.md §3.1). The repository's README is inside the input root but is not Cypher, so loading it fails with 422. This puts the server in a known state however the run starts.
